name: Dashboard
summary: Answer 'how are we doing and what needs attention?' in one glance, then let people drill in.
principles: The top of the page answers the main question with 3 to 5 key numbers.
Density is a feature for expert tools, but alignment and a strict grid keep it calm.
Charts serve a question; every chart has a title that states the insight or the measure.
Neutral chrome, color reserved for data and status.
Tables beat cards for comparing many items.
structure_note: App shell with a left sidebar (collapsible) or top navigation, a page header with title, date range and primary action, a KPI row, then charts and tables on a 12-column grid with consistent gutters.

sections.name: Navigation shell
sections.purpose: Move between areas without losing context.
guidance: Left sidebar with grouped text labels and outline icons; the current item uses the accent with a subtle surface_alt background.
Collapse to icons at medium widths; to a top bar plus menu on mobile.
Workspace or account switcher at the top, user menu at the bottom.

sections.name: Page header
sections.purpose: Say what this view is and set its scope.
guidance: Title (headline role), a short description if needed, date-range or filter controls, one primary action right-aligned.
Filters show their active state and can be cleared in one click.

sections.name: Key numbers
sections.purpose: The 3 to 5 numbers that answer the main question.
guidance: Each: label (label role, muted), value (headline role, tabular numerals), change versus the previous period with sign and icon, not color alone.
Same height and alignment; no sparkline unless it adds information.

sections.name: Charts
guidance: Line charts for trends, bars for comparisons; avoid pie charts with more than 4 slices and all 3D charts.
Use one series color (the accent) plus neutrals; add more hues only for genuinely categorical data, in a deliberate order.
Light gridlines, direct labels where possible, tooltips with exact values.

sections.name: Data table
sections.purpose: Compare and act on many items.
guidance: Sticky header, left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers with tabular figures, row height 40-48.
Sorting on clear headers, row actions on hover plus a visible overflow menu for touch and keyboard.
Status as a small labeled badge (dot + text), not a full colored row.

states.name: Empty
states.guidance: Explain what will show here and how to get data in (connect, import, invite).

states.name: Loading
states.guidance: Skeleton KPI tiles and table rows; keep layout stable so nothing jumps.

states.name: Partial data
states.guidance: Mark incomplete periods clearly (dashed line, 'so far' label).

states.name: Error
states.guidance: Per-widget errors with retry; one failing chart does not blank the page.

states.name: No permission
states.guidance: Say who can grant access instead of hiding the area silently.

accessibility: Charts have a text alternative (summary sentence or data table).
Status uses text and icons, never color alone.
Full keyboard support for tables, filters and menus; visible focus.
Numbers and units are read correctly (for example aria-label '12.4 percent increase').
avoid: Dark navy dashboards with neon charts
A card for every number with heavy shadows
Gauges and speedometers for simple numbers
